subject.title: Workspaces: add scoped Teams control hub

question: Should OpenClaw make one Gateway a supported authorization boundary for less-trusted local Teams members, or preserve the documented same-trust model and place those members behind a separate gateway or service boundary?
rationale: Tests cannot decide whether the repository's permanent security promise, public plugin API, and operator trust model should change; that requires explicit maintainer intent before implementation details can be accepted.

options.title: Preserve the current boundary
options.body: Keep one Gateway same-trust and move external-member authentication and isolation behind a separate gateway or service while retaining only narrowly approved generic resource seams.

options.title: Adopt Teams in core
options.body: Approve a first-class multi-user Gateway boundary, then require a threat model, security documentation, stable plugin API review, upgrade proof, and live adversarial validation before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the focused specification open but pause or close this implementation until a maintainer sponsors the product and security model.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current boundary
recommendation.body: Keep one Gateway same-trust and move external-member authentication and isolation behind a separate gateway or service while retaining only narrowly approved generic resource seams.

likelyOwner.reason: This changes the repository-wide Gateway trust promise and therefore needs repository-level product and security authority.
